title: Your peace is a threat to their chaos. 🛡️ Don’t apologize for leveling up and stepping away from the drama. When you choose God’s peace, the enemy gets loud because he just lost control over you. Stand firm in your boundaries. You aren't losing friends; you're gaining sanity.
paragraphs: Your peace is a threat to their chaos. 🛡️ Don’t apologize for leveling up and stepping away from the drama. When you choose God’s peace, the enemy gets loud because he just lost control over you. Stand firm in your boundaries. You aren't losing friends; you're gaining sanity.
📖 "Above all else, guard your heart, for everything you do flows from it." - Proverbs 4:23
